events.what: Frame-0 downbeat: felt kick + sub A1 + muted Am stab (A3-C4-E4), all through the 900 Hz low-pass. No lead-in: first sample is the hit.
Reversed open-hat pickup swells and ends exactly on 90 (the cut to the chip montage).
Muted bass stab A1/A2 on the “Só um minutinho.” slam (riser-2bar SFX starts here, not in the music).
Low piano A1 + E2 (additive, inharmonic strings) as the counter lands on 40 min.
Bar 4 downbeat (“Chutar as horas?”): kick; snare 8ths 180-202.5, 16ths 210-221.25, crescendo.
Under-water low-pass opens exponentially 900 Hz -> 3 kHz between 180 and 224 (Q 1.05, every stem).
Hard stop of every stem at sample 360000 (2 ms fade); intro reverb/delay/filter tails are truncated with it.
Frames 225-239 are digital zero in music.wav and every stem (no tail, no pickup, no dither).
THE DROP: first sample of the main timeline. Long kick + sub A1 + crash + wide 7-voice supersaw Am (A2-A4), full range.
Snare accent layered on the beat-2 clap (UBI lands, descriptor finishes).
Bar 6: crash, chord to F (F2-A4 wide), the pluck hook A-C-E-G enters (FM + polyBLEP pluck, dotted-8th ping-pong).
High-pass lift on every stem, 22 Hz -> 1.1 kHz over 345-359, plus a reverse-crash swell ending on 360; snaps back to full range on 360.
Crash + groove A: 4-on-the-floor kick, clap 2/4, swung 16th hats, sub + off-beat mid bass on Am-F-C-G, pluck hook.
Pluck C6 accent on the bar-8 downbeat (sits with ding_2); the hook note under it is kept, the rest of the bar is the normal hook.
Open-hat accent with a short band-passed noise swell ending on 450 (the whip into Categorias).
STOP-TIME stab 1 (beat 3, “Regras,”): kick + clap + C-chord supersaw stab + bass stab together; the groove is silent 510-539 between stabs.
Stop-time stab 2 (beat 4, “memória,”): same band hit on C.
Stop-time stab 3 + crash (bar 10 downbeat, “IA.”) on G; the groove resumes from here.
Floor-tom accent (G2-ish, pitch drop) with the beat-4 clap on the cut to Revisão.
One-beat fill 645-659: tom-snare-tom-snare 16ths, crescendo; hook, pad and hats stop at 645 to set up the stop.
Band STOP: one Am stab on the downbeat, then only the sub tail (A1, 0.5 s decay) and closed-hat 8ths; the 675 hat is -8 dB and nothing melodic sounds on 675 (key-down alone).
Groove re-enters on beat 3 (key -> chip morph): kick, clap, hats, sub, bass, hook + bell counter-melody E5-G5-A5 (C-major pentatonic, additive bell).
Bar 13 downbeat (rule chips): soft crash, chord to F.
Bar 14 downbeat (cut to “Confirmar os 19”): open-hat accent; a reverse crash swell starts here and ends on 810.
THE CLICK: full-band stab + crash, harmony lifts Am -> C with the pad filter opening (3.6 -> 5.2 kHz) — peak of the features act.
C-major-pentatonic sparkle C6-D6-E6-G6-A6-C7 in 12ths of a beat, 885-897.5 (sits with shimmer_2).
UBI lands: clap on the downbeat + A5 bell; groove C = same drums + ride quarters, octave 8th bass, bright 16th arp over the hook.
Thinned drums 930-959: kick, clap, ride and 16ths out; only soft closed-hat 8ths under the clock.
Bell E6 as the clock lands on 18:00 (sits with ding_1).
Soft hit (kick 0.8 + soft crash): drums back in as the report window rises.
Pluck C6 with the “Copiar Markdown” click.
Full-band Am stab + low “no” synth (A1/E2/A2 saws, pitch falls a whole step, filter closes); groove holes 1035-1049 and resumes on 1050.
Bar 19 downbeat (“Ok, foco!”): light crash, chord to G.
Snare flam + open hat on beat 4 (the whip into Configurações).
Lift: drums thin to kick + 16th hats (no clap), warm Am9 pad (1.5 kHz, slow attack) enters, hook/pads under a 5.2 kHz low-pass.
Bar 21 downbeat (“IA do Ubi” click): pad moves to G(add9).
Drums out on beat 3 (last kick 1215, hats end 1229); pad, sub and hook carry into the breather.
Breather: no kick; Fmaj9 pad (F2-C3-E3-G3-A3), sub pulse on quarters (F1).
Soft pluck E5 on beat 2 (address chip); pad moves to Am9 on 1290 with A1 sub pulses.
Kick returns on quarters (1320-1365) under riser_1bar_1; pad to G(add9), sub G1.
Snare roll 8ths (1350, 1357.5) -> 16ths (1365-1376.25); HPF 24 -> 320 Hz and LPF 1.7 -> 17 kHz sweep up on every non-drum stem into 1380.
FINAL HIT: long kick + sub A1 + crash + wide Am(add9) supersaw; drums end here.
Soft low thump (90 -> 46 Hz sine, no click) as UBI lands on the lockup (sits with bloop_1).
Am(add9) resolves to Cadd9 (C3-G3-D4-E4-G4), sub glides A1 -> C2; slow pluck echo A4 (1380), E5 (1410) on long ping-pong delay.
Two-note goodbye: C5 (1440) -> A4 (1455), pluck + bell, as UBI waves.
Tail: low-pass closes 18 kHz -> 180 Hz on every stem while the level fades; reverb decays inside the fade.
Last non-zero sample is before frame 1556 (sample 2489600); frames 1556-1559 are digital zero.
